title: Later Servex crashes (native) need an admin step; 61 stale dev servers

owner_note.text: The 01:24 and 02:25 crashes were native fast-fails with no JavaScript stack; only Windows crash dumps (WER LocalDumps, needs an admin shell) can name them, steps are in restart.md. Memory looks like a contributor (437 MB free and 93% commit at 02:25, about 61 leaked worktree dev servers using ~4 GB) but the first three crashes had 15 GB free, so it is not proven. Clearing the stale worktree dev servers is the cheap next step; the minute log does not yet record commit charge (filed as an improvement).
